messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — we're rolling Metrics Contract v2 today. This changes the SDK telemetry hook shape (enriched counters + route tags). Need eyes on Python/Go/TS clients.
ella: What exactly is different? quick summary pls.
mara: Main change: SDKs must send `rd-metrics` JSON blob as a header on each request instead of simple numeric counters. Example: `RD-METRICS: {\"counters\":{\"tokens\":123},\"route\":\"payments-us\"}`
alexg: Oof — that will break our Go client middleware if we don't ship a compatibility shim. Current lib expects `X-RD-TOKEN-COUNT` int header.
pm_ryan: Is this required for rollout or opt-in? Product wants per-route attribution for the dashboard launch next week.
sanjay: It's required for the dashboard rollout. We can enable a server-side fallback for 2 weeks but we'd prefer SDKs upgrade ASAP.
ella: Can we add a header-negotiation flag? Like `RD-METRICS-V: 1|2` so older SDKs still work and server parses legacy header when v missing.
mara: We implemented negotiation in the server, but it only works if SDK sends the version header. Otherwise the gateway assumes legacy. Negotiation won't help old SDKs that don't send anything.
ops-ci: Deploy-bot: rolling metrics-v2 parser to staging at 12:05 UTC :wrench:
alexg: For Go I'll add a middleware that synthesizes the old header from the new blob for backwards compatibility (quick patch). But TS/Node SDK has many downstream deps — need a deprecation schedule.
pm_ryan: Docs + console UX needs a clear banner: "Metric contract v2 required after Mar 5" and migration guide snippet.
ella: I'll draft a short migration in the repo README and a console alert. Also tagging affected SDK owners.
sanjay: Also watch quota meters — Contract v2 adds `route` dimension, which will split quotas per route. That may surface unexpected throttles. We should run a canary with traffic split 5%.
mara: Agreed. Suggest server fallback policy: if header blob malformed, fallback to legacy counters and emit a telemetry event `metrics.v2.failure` so we can find stuck clients.
alexg: Quick question: are we changing any sampling semantics? TS client uses a local sampler to avoid noise.
sanjay: No sampling changes for now. Keep client sampling. Server will do aggregation by route after ingest.
pm_ryan: Can we add a Console panel under Observability > Metrics that shows per-route quota usage and highlights any clients still sending legacy headers? That will help SRE and PMs.
ella: I'll file a Console ticket and wire a small telemetry endpoint to list `metrics.version` per api_key.
ops-ci: Deploy-bot: staging parser up. Run smoke with internal services.
sanjay: Thanks. Action items: Alex — patch Go shim and open PR today. Mara/DevEx — migration guide + console banner. Ella — add telemetry event for malformed blobs. PM_Ryan — coordinate the canary schedule.
pm_ryan: Ack. I'll coordinate with SRE for 5% canary at 16:00 UTC.
alexg: Starting Go PR now, will include tests for both v1 and v2 header shapes. :shipit:
ella: Reminder: let's include example snippets for Python, TS, and Go in the guide, plus curl example: ```curl -H "RD-METRICS: {\"counters\":{\"tokens\":12},\"route\":\"ui-eu\"}" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate```
sanjay: Perfect. Post updates here when PRs are ready or if you hit blockers.
deploy-bot: staging smoke passed for metrics-v2 parser.
ops-ci: prod rollout planned after 2-hour canary unless we see regression. :eyes:
